list: Leonida Platinum — the official 55 trophies, with sourced guides

trophies.guide: The platinum is the finish line, not a task of its own: it pops once the other 54 are done. Budget a very long playthrough — the full run is estimated at around 200 hours — and keep cheats off entirely, since they switch trophies off. The 100% completion trophy is the hardest single step on the road, so plan the endgame around it.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.short: Earn every other trophy to take the platinum.

steps.text: Earn the other 54 trophies first — the platinum unlocks once they are all done.
Plan for a long haul: the full run is estimated at around 200 hours.
Save the 100% completion trophy for the endgame — it is rated the hardest on the list.
Do not use cheats at any point — they switch trophies off.

trophies.guide: Story trophy — finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing, and it unlocks as the story gets going.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.short: Finish the opening mission Gone Fishing.

trophies.guide: Story trophy — play through to the end of Chapter 1.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Story trophy — play through to the end of Chapter 2.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Story trophy — play through to the end of Chapter 3.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Story trophy — play through to the end of Chapter 4.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Story trophy — finish the final mission to close the story. It is the only gold trophy tied to a mission, so it lands late in the run.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Story trophy — complete the Breakfast Run mission when it comes up in the story.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Story trophy — complete The Cartel Heist mission when it comes up in the story.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Story trophy — complete the Child's Play mission when it comes up in the story.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Story trophy — complete the Headliners mission when it comes up in the story.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Story trophy — complete the VCIA Takedown mission when it comes up in the story.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Story trophy — complete the Operation Savage Glory mission when it comes up in the story.
trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.short: Complete the Operation Savage Glory mission.

trophies.guide: The hardest trophy on the list: push the completion counter all the way to 100% by clearing story, side strands, activities and collectibles. There is no mission replay and no New Game Plus, so anything missable has to be done on the way rather than after the credits. Check the counter often and save the cleanup for the endgame.
trophies.name: A Long Road

steps.text: Clear story, side strands, activities and collectibles — 100% covers the whole game, not one mode.
There is no mission replay and no New Game Plus, so finish anything missable on the way, not after the credits.
Treat this as the hardest trophy on the list and track your percentage as you go.

trophies.guide: Land stunts while driving — jumps, drifts and near misses all feed the counter — until it reaches 250. It builds up across normal play, so finish the rest by repeating stunt-friendly driving late in the game.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Sample each type of activity the game offers at least once — races, the shooting range, fishing, the arcade, bowling and the rest. You do not need to win or master any of them; one try of each type is enough.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: The range holds 42 challenges, and every one of them needs a gold medal. Work through them weapon by weapon, replaying any challenge that lands below gold until it clears. Short focused sessions beat long tired ones when the margins are tight.
trophies.name: The Shootist

steps.text: Replay a challenge until the gold result feels repeatable before moving to the next one.
Work through the range in short sessions so tired aim does not cost you golds.

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of its locations. Learn one course at a time and repeat it until the win lands; the trophy needs a victory everywhere, not just a single win.
trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.short: Win a Top Fun drone race at every location.

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races across Leonida's race scene. Mix race types and keep track of which events are already won so you do not repeat a victory that counts only once.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Take Cal on in a fishing challenge and beat him. Get comfortable with the reeling rhythm in a few casual fishing sessions first, so the challenge itself is not your first time holding a rod.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.short: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.

trophies.guide: Play one arcade game through to its end. Any cabinet counts — pick the game you enjoy most and finish a full run of it.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Follow Andy's mission strand to its last mission and complete it.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Follow Kenton's mission strand to its last mission and complete it.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Follow Billy's mission strand to its last mission and complete it.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish eight full stranger mission strands scattered across Leonida. Strangers appear as you explore, so keep an eye out while travelling and clear each strand when it opens.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Follow Randy's mission strand to its last mission and complete it.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Follow Tyrone's mission strand to its last mission and complete it.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.

dispute.a: KeenGamer describes it as only potentially missable.
dispute.b: PlanetGTA6 notes that no reliable missable list exists yet.

trophies.guide: The one trophy you can genuinely miss. There are 18 meditation spots across Leonida, and Lucia's balcony spot in Chapter 1 vanishes once that chapter ends — with no mission replay and no New Game Plus to go back for it. Start meditating in Chapter 1 and keep going until every spot is done.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.short: Meditate at all 18 spots — start in Chapter 1.

steps.text: Start in Chapter 1: Lucia's balcony meditation counts toward the 18.
Visit every meditation spot across Leonida until all 18 are done.
Do the balcony spot before Chapter 1 ends — it is gone after that chapter.
Remember there is no mission replay, so a skipped spot cannot be replayed later.
Treat this as the only potentially missable trophy on the list.

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Track down the unique animal Bret wants hunted and take it down for him. The hunt opens through Bret's strand — follow it until the target animal is named, then go after it.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Collectible cards come in sets — finish three full sets to take this one. Pick up cards wherever you find them across Leonida and work toward three complete sets.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK feature at 100 different locations around Leonida. Fold it into your travel — a quick stop whenever you reach somewhere new — and the counter climbs without a dedicated grind.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Finish 50 of the game's challenges. Challenges cover driving, combat, exploration and more, so a varied playthrough fills the counter; check the list and chase the easiest unfinished ones at the end.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner alongside, build a four-star wanted level and then lose the heat and escape. Open ground and a fast car help — break line of sight, then stay out of the search until the stars drop.
trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.short: Escape a 4-star wanted level with your partner.

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Robberies open up in Chapters 3–4, so this one starts mid-story. With your partner, rob three shops in a row without losing your wanted level between them — plan the route, keep the getaways clean, and do not stop for anything else in between.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.short: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner.

trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles across Leonida. Drive everything you see — parked, moving or mission-supplied — and the discovery log fills up as you explore new corners of the state.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Trigger Combat Focus and take down five enemies before it runs out. Pick a crowded firefight, line the targets up first, then activate it and work through them quickly.
trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.short: Down 5 enemies in one Combat Focus.

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: At launch there is still no confirmed way to trigger this one — the description hints at leaving VCIA off-schedule, but no guide has pinned down a reliable method yet. Treat it as unconfirmed and check back once the community finds a repeatable route.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.short: Leave VCIA off-schedule — method unconfirmed at launch.

trophies.guide: At launch there is still no confirmed way to trigger this one — the description points at Rhino tanks, but no guide has pinned down a reliable method yet. Treat it as unconfirmed and check back once the community finds a repeatable route.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.short: Rhino tanks — method unconfirmed at launch.

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without ever being detected. Go in quiet, watch the sightlines, and get out before anyone raises the alarm — one spotted moment ruins the attempt. Robberies open up in Chapters 3–4.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob five bank vaults and escape clean each time. Plan each hit, keep the getaway vehicle close, and treat every vault as its own job — the trophy needs all five escapes.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Hit an armored truck and escape with the take. Ambush it on a quiet stretch, grab what is inside, then break away fast before backup arrives.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.short: Rob an armored truck and escape.

trophies.guide: Explore every corner of Leonida until the map is filled in. Drive the highways, wander the back roads and visit the smaller towns — this one rewards covering ground, not finishing missions.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each gang in the state. Work through the gangs one at a time and keep track of which ones are already done — the trophy needs the full set.
trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.short: Rob an illegal operation for each gang.

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: At launch there is still no confirmed way to trigger this one — the description points at a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach, but no guide has pinned down a reliable method yet. Treat it as unconfirmed and check back once the community finds a repeatable route.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.short: Cocktail on Ocean Beach — method unconfirmed at launch.

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: At launch there is still no confirmed way to trigger this one — the description points at smashing out of a vehicle showroom, but no guide has pinned down a reliable method yet. Treat it as unconfirmed and check back once the community finds a repeatable route.
trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.short: Smash out of a showroom — method unconfirmed at launch.

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Head to the bowling alley run by Kolt & Associates and play through a game, following through on your throws. Any finished game counts.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.short: Play bowling at the Kolt & Associates alley.

trophies.guide: The exact trigger for this one is not yet confirmed by any cited source — the description hints at a partnership with mass appeal, but nothing reliable is documented at launch. Treat it as unconfirmed and check back once players pin it down.
trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.short: Partnership with mass appeal — trigger unconfirmed.

trophies.guide: The exact trigger for this one is not yet confirmed by any cited source — the description only says choices were made, for better or worse, and no count or method is documented at launch. Treat it as unconfirmed and check back once players pin it down.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: At launch there is still no confirmed way to trigger this one — the description hints that the second try is the charm, but no guide has pinned down a reliable method yet. Treat it as unconfirmed and check back once the community finds a repeatable route.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.short: Second time's the charm — method unconfirmed at launch.

trophies.guide: At launch there is still no confirmed way to trigger this one — the description suggests witnessing something strange, but no guide has pinned down a reliable method yet. Treat it as unconfirmed and check back once the community finds a repeatable route.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.short: Witness something strange — method unconfirmed at launch.

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: At launch there is still no confirmed way to trigger this one — the description points at knocking someone over with a melee drive-by, but no guide has pinned down a reliable method yet. Treat it as unconfirmed and check back once the community finds a repeatable route.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.short: Melee drive-by knockdown — method unconfirmed at launch.

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies and other scores — hand them to a contact over time and the total adds up across the playthrough.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across the shops of Leonida. Weapons, clothes, vehicles and upgrades all count — normal spending across a full playthrough gets most of the way there, so finish it with a big purchase late in the game.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Buy every garage property on the market. Garages give you somewhere to store the vehicles you collect, so pick them up as the money allows and finish the set in the endgame.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles through the Scooter Bros app. Find cars and bikes worth keeping, send them through the app one by one, and the count climbs to ten.
trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.short: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app.
